system.description: Dazzlers are spinning laser devices, designed to blind targets and defeat surveillance. Anyone within line of sight in the radius of effect (50 meters) who is not equipped with anti-glare mods must succeed in a REF Check or be blinded ▶226 for 1 action turn, +1 per superior failure. A critical failure results in permanent blindness (until repaired/healed). Any visual light/infrared cameras are overloaded for the dazzler’s duration. Unless set to a timed deactivation, dazzlers continue to blind for 1 hour or until wirelessly turned off or physically destroyed (DUR 10, AV 5/10).
